career_ladder.note: Rajasva Lekhpal is the frontline village-level revenue official under the Board of Revenue (Rajasva Parishad), Government of Uttar Pradesh, responsible for maintaining rural cadastral maps (Shajra), village khasra/khatauni land records, crop surveys, and disaster relief enumeration. Direct recruits enter at Pay Level 3 and advance through departmental promotion exams and seniority.

exam_scheme.note: Selection to Rajasva Lekhpal comprises preliminary shortlisting of candidates through their normalized UPSSSC PET score, followed by a single-stage Main Written Examination consisting of 100 objective MCQs across four subjects. There is no interview (Group C interviews were abolished by UP Government). Negative marking is 0.25 marks (1/4th) per wrong answer.

financial_package.note: Rajasva Lekhpal is assigned Pay Level 3 (Pay Band ₹5,200–₹20,200 with Grade Pay ₹2,000) under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016. In addition to basic salary, Lekhpals receive specific field stationery allowances and cycle/travel maintenance allowances.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 3 entry basic pay of ₹21,700 at 58% DA (effective 01.07.2025), HRA (₹1,800 to ₹3,600 based on district classification), field maintenance allowance, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹3,429) and group insurance scheme deductions.
official_perks: House Rent Allowance (HRA) based on tehsil / district headquarters posting
Stationery & map maintenance allowance (Basta Allowance) for revenue records
Medical facility under UP Government Servants Medical Rules
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution
